avis.titre: Finally a solution for cystic acne
avis.texte: I rarely write reviews, but I felt the need to share the impact this product has had on my skin and confidence. I have had cystic acne since I was a teenager (now 36), and I have tried everything. I use this mask every other day after cleansing my face, and the next morning my smaller breakouts are gone while my cysts are much smaller. Within a few rounds of this mask, my cystic acne disappears. It also makes my skin feel much smoother. I highly recommend this product if you have any acne but especially cystic acne.

avis.titre: LIFE CHANGING FOR FUNGAL AND HORMONAL ACNE.
avis.texte: I have struggled with hormonal acne for years, and recently it began to get much worse. I had tiny red bumps and whiteheads everywhere, especially around the chin and forehead, and I noticed it would get better after a professional Oxygen facial or hydrafacial, but would quickly returned. It seemed to get worse any time I oil cleansed or wore makeup. I started to think that maybe this is fungal, and did some research. I found that Sulfur is a good ingredient for combatting both fungal and regular acne so I wanted to try that before trying a prescription anti fungal. I found this mask and read the reviews and bought the mask. After ONE USE, the breakout was almost 100% gone. All the red textured bumps are gone and any pustular spots are dried up and healing. My face looks like a completely different person. I have never been so happy with a product in my life. The 5% sulfur is pure gold. I AM SO HAPPY THANK YOU TO THIS PRODUCT.

Helps clean out the skin to get rid of acne. Works best in conjunction with other acne products, but a great once a week addition into my skincare routine. I like the texture when I apply it. It does leave a bit of scent on the skin from the active sulfur ingredient, but I expected that and it doesn't bother me.

I'll definitely be using this a few times a week. I'm very pleased with the results.

I'll start by saying I never leave reviews on products I use, no matter how much I love them. But if this review can help someone struggling with their acne the way I was then I have to leave one. This mask diminishes all active breaks outs and calms the look of redness INSTANTLY. My skin has been purging from using the Dr. Dennis extra strength peel pads. As a result, I have a lot of blemishes coming to head and dark marks left behind once they're gone. After about 5 weeks of purging and wearing makeup to mask the imperfections, I started using this mask to relieve the blemishes, redness, and dark marks. The results were instant! There isn't another "rapid relief" product I've used thats worked the way this one has. I wouldn't say this product has any cons. Just make sure to properly hydrate your skin afterwards!
